name: Handwrytten
description: Handwrytten lets you send real, robot-handwritten notes and cards at scale -- directly from Claude. Use it to browse card designs, compose personalized messages, manage recipient addresses, and place orders for physical mail without leaving your conversation. Ideal for sales outreach, customer retention, employee recognition, and relationship marketing, Handwrytten combines the authenticity of a handwritten note with the efficiency of automation. Trigger thank-you cards, follow-ups, and campaigns through natural language, and let Claude handle the details.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Handwrytten to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Handwrytten to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.handwrytten.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Handwrytten MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Handwrytten lists 48 MCP tools, including Preview-Cards, Preview-Writing, View-Basket, add_recipient, add_sender, basket_add_order, basket_clear, basket_clear_all, basket_count, basket_list, basket_remove, and basket_remove_item.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Handwrytten?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Handwrytten in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Handwrytten requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Handwrytten is developed by Handwrytten. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
